title: ParameterIDs (complete v1.0 inventory), APVTS, PluginProcessor with sidechain bus
description:
Implement stable v1.0 parameter IDs, APVTS layout, and PluginProcessor bus topology with sidechain support. This task is the sole owner of CMakeLists.txt target_sources additions for ParameterIDs/layout if needed, and sole owner of PluginProcessor / ParameterIDs in this phase.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source-related conventions in /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/PluginProcessor.h
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/chuggate/.abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md (parameters, bus layouts, key source)
- CMakeLists.txt from a.1

Implement Source/ParameterIDs.h with complete stable string/paramID inventory for v1.0:
Global: enabled, mode (Chug/Lead/Hybrid/Manual), topology (FullBand/DualBand/TriBand/HissCurtain), gainMode (HardGate/SoftGate/DownwardExpander), thresholdOpen (-100..0 dBFS), hysteresis (0.5..24 dB) — thresholdClose is DERIVED as open-hysteresis and MUST NOT be a stored parameter — attack, hold, release, maxAdaptiveRelease, floor, ratio, knee, curve, lookahead, outputTrim, bypass.
Key: source, externalBlend, hpfEnabled, hpfFrequency, hpfSlope, lpfEnabled, lpfFrequency, lpfSlope, emphasisFreq, emphasisGain, emphasisQ, humMode (off/50Hz/60Hz/auto), humHarmonics, humNotchQ, humImmunityAmount, alignmentOffset, fallbackMode, listenMode.
AttackGuard: enabled, amount, sensitivity, frequency, decay, softNoteAssist, maxThresholdReduction, confirmationWindow.
Sustain: enabled, amount, releaseExtension, harmonicWeight, decayWeight, noiseWeight, feedbackEnabled, feedbackSensitivity, feedbackMinDuration, feedbackMaxHold, feedbackFreqMin, feedbackFreqMax, feedbackFloor, feedbackRequireExtKey, feedbackSafetyTimeout.
Cadence: enabled, amount, releaseFraction, sourceMode (audio/hostTempo/combined/off).
Noise learn: snrMargin, adaptiveEnabled, adaptiveRate.
Per-band low/mid/high: floor, thresholdOffset, attackOffset, holdOffset, releaseMultiplier, solo, mute, detectorWeighting.
HissCurtain: minFreq, maxFreq, depth.
Stereo: linkMode, linkAmount.
Crossovers: dualFreq, triLowFreq, triHighFreq.
Audition: rejectedMode (off/all/fullBand/weight/voice/hiss/hissCurtain/noiseModel/key), stateFilterMode (off/hold/sustain/release/closed).
Profile/tuning index and A/B state selectors as parameters where appropriate.

Implement Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
- ChugGateAudioProcessor : juce::AudioProcessor with APVTS created from a createParameterLayout() covering ParameterIDs.
- BusesProperties: main input, optional sidechain input, output. isBusesLayoutSupported must accept mono, stereo, and stereo+sidechain (mono or stereo SC); Standalone must operate safely without external sidechain.
- processBlock stub (clear MIDI, no-op/pass-through ok).
- getStateInformation/setStateInformation rockets through APVTS ValueTree; include schema_version property support hook (full StateManager integration lands in a.3).
- createEditor returns editor forward-declared; hasEditor true.

Update CMakeLists.txt ONLY as needed so ParameterIDs/layout compilation units are listed if split files are added under Source/.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/ParameterIDs.h exists and declares stable v1.0 parameter ID constants covering global, key, AttackGuard, Sustain/Feedback, Cadence, noise learn, per-band, HissCurtain, stereo, crossovers, audition, and profile/A-B IDs
thresholdClose is not a stored APVTS parameter; only thresholdOpen and hysteresis are stored
Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp define ChugGateAudioProcessor with APVTS
PluginProcessor configures main input, optional sidechain input, and output via BusesProperties
isBusesLayoutSupported accepts mono, stereo, and stereo+sidechain layouts and allows standalone without sidechain
processBlock stub compiles; getStateInformation/setStateInformation round-trip APVTS state with schema_version property
CMakeLists.txt target_sources includes PluginProcessor.cpp (and any new layout .cpp if added)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: store thresholdClose as a discrete parameter
modify Source/PluginEditor.* beyond forward declarations needed to compile

allowed: put createParameterLayout in PluginProcessor.cpp or a thin ParameterLayout companion only if still under allowed_write_paths
derive display-only thresholdClose as open minus hysteresis
forbidden: introduce a second parameter system besides APVTS
implement Noise Learn / alignment DSP engines in this task
